chunks: Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from ʿAlī ibn Ismāʿīl, from Ḥammād, from Ḥarīz, from Ibn Abī Yaʿfūr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If you doubt and do not know whether you are in three, or in two, or in one, or in four, then repeat, and do not proceed upon doubt.
ai.seo_question: What should one do in salat (prayer) if one doubts the number of rakʿahs and cannot determine it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt in salat (prayer). When a person becomes uncertain in a way that leaves the rakʿah count fundamentally indeterminate, he must repeat the prayer and must not continue on the basis of unresolved doubt.
